risks.title: Cybersecurity and IT Incidents
risks.score_rationale: The risk is explicitly mentioned in Item 1A as a major issue. The language emphasizes oversight by the board and CISO, with escalation protocols, indicating high severity. The company has an active cybersecurity risk management program, reinforcing the risk's importance. The Cybersecurity category is heavily weighted here.

risks.title: Litigation and Legal Proceedings
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in Item 3, the company is involved in routine litigation but indicates these will not have a material effect on financial statements. The language is reassuring, but the risk exists. Centrally positioned in the report, but with moderate intensity.

risks.title: Dependence on New Technologies
risks.score_rationale: The company invests heavily (6.4% of revenue) in R&D and relies on innovation (e.g., AirSense 11). The risk of failure or delay in development is implicit. Although not directly stated as a risk, the strategic context makes it critical.

risks.title: Competition in the Medical Devices Market
risks.score_rationale: The sector is described as dynamic and competitive. While not detailed in the excerpts, the strategic positioning and R&D investments suggest strong competitive pressure. An implicit but central risk in the medical sector.

risks.title: Increasing Cybersecurity Regulation
risks.score_rationale: The text explicitly mentions the CISO and board monitoring emerging cybersecurity regulations. This indicates increased exposure to legal obligations. The risk is rising with the evolving regulatory landscape.

ai_positioning.summary: Company RMD does not mention artificial intelligence (AI) or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F report.
